source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: Movie Night: Finding Nemo
events.tagline: Enjoy an outdoor family-friendly screening of Finding Nemo under the stars at Downtown Cary Park.
events.description: Downtown Cary Park hosts a free outdoor movie night featuring Finding Nemo on Friday, July 17, 2026, from 6–10 PM at the Great Lawn Pavilion, with food trucks on site and pre-screening activities starting at 6 PM.

events.name: Third Friday Durham Art Walk & Gallery Crawl
events.tagline: Downtown Durham's monthly free art walk featuring gallery receptions, exhibits, and performances from 6–9 PM.
events.description: Third Friday Durham is a recurring monthly art walk where downtown galleries and venues host free opening receptions and exhibits from 6–9 PM on the third Friday of each month[1][2].

events.name: Oyster Fest
events.tagline: Shuck and slurp your way through The Durham's fifth annual summer celebration of North Carolina oysters, summer flavors, and live music.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 4 PM–12 AM · Sat 4 PM–12 AM · Sun 2–8 PM
events.freeNote: No tickets or reservations required; oyster-forward specials and craft cocktails priced individually
events.description: Oyster Fest 2026 is a four-night rooftop event at The Durham Hotel featuring North Carolina oysters, summer cocktails, live music, and an oyster shooter bar on Friday and Saturday.

events.name: Lindsey Stirling - Duality Untamed Tour
events.tagline: Electronic violinist Lindsey Stirling brings her groundbreaking fusion of dance, aerial artistry, and electronic violin to Raleigh with special guest PVRIS.
events.description: Lindsey Stirling's 32-date North American Duality Untamed Tour features her signature electronic violin performance alongside special guest PVRIS at Red Hat Amphitheater on July 17, 2026.

events.name: Phish
events.tagline: Legendary jam rock band Phish performs their Summer 2026 tour at Raleigh's iconic outdoor venue.
events.venue: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek
events.description: Phish, the iconic jam band known for intricate improvisations and experimental jazz, performs at Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek on Friday, July 17, 2026, with doors opening at 5:30 PM and the show starting at 7:00 PM[1][3][5].

events.name: The Notebook
events.tagline: Fall in love again with the Broadway musical based on the iconic film and bestselling novel.
events.description: The Notebook is a Broadway musical based on the best-selling novel and iconic film, telling the story of Allie and Noah's lifetime of love despite threatening forces [6][7].

events.name: Durham Bulls v. Charlotte Knights
events.tagline: Three-game homestand kicks off with fireworks and first pitch at 6:45 PM
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6:45 PM · Sat 6:45 PM · Sun 5:00 PM
events.description: The Durham Bulls begin a three-game homestand against the Charlotte Knights at Durham Bulls Athletic Park on Friday, July 17, 2026, featuring fireworks, Margaritaville Night, and the debut of the 2026 Bull Sharks identity[1].

events.name: Dog Days of Summer Morrisville 2026
events.tagline: A tail-wagging evening under the stars featuring splash pools, pup cups, food trucks, music, and themed contests for your furry friends.
events.freeNote: Free admission, but a Dog Park pass is required to attend
events.description: Hosted by the Town of Morrisville, this family-friendly event celebrates Sirius, the dog star, with splash pools, pup cups, food trucks, local vendors, and music for dogs and their owners [2][4].

events.name: 2026 NASCAR Regional Season - Swift Creek 175
events.tagline: NASCAR Regional Series Late Model Stock Car racing at Wake County Speedway's 175-lap Bullring showdown
events.scheduleNote: Gates 6 PM · Qualifying 7:20 PM · Racing 8:30 PM
events.freeNote: Adults $18; Seniors/Military/Students $15; Children 12 and under FREE
events.description: The Swift Creek 175 is a 175-lap NASCAR Regional Series Late Model Stock Car race at Wake County Speedway's quarter-mile bullring, with gates opening at 6 PM and racing starting at 8:30 PM on Friday.

events.name: ADF Presents: Shen Wei Dance Arts and Guangdong Modern Dance Company
events.tagline: Experience the US premiere of MindScape, the first co-production between Shen Wei Dance Arts and Guangdong Modern Dance Company.
events.description: This ADF co-commission presents the US premiere of MindScape, a 60–70 minute work featuring US dancers from Shen Wei Dance Arts and Chinese dancers from Guangdong Modern Dance Company.

events.name: ADF Closing Dance Party
events.tagline: Live DJ, buffet, and two drink tickets to dance the night away with Shen Wei Dance Arts and Guangdong Modern Dance Company.
events.description: The 2026 American Dance Festival season closing party features a live DJ, buffet dinner, and two drink tickets for beer or wine, with all proceeds supporting the ADF scholarship fund[1].

events.name: Pauly Shore
events.tagline: Comedy legend Pauly Shore takes the stage at Goodnights Comedy Club for a special weekend event.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7:00 PM & 9:15 PM · Sat 7:00 PM & 9:30 PM · Sun 7:00 PM
events.description: Pauly Shore performs multiple comedy shows over three days at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh, with Friday shows at 7:00 PM and 9:15 PM.

events.name: Ian Lara
events.tagline: Comedy show featuring Ian Lara at Room 861 inside Goodnights Comedy Club
events.description: Ian Lara performs comedy at Room 861, an intimate venue inside Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh, with shows at 7:30 PM and 9:45 PM on Friday, July 17, 2026[1][2][8].

events.name: NCMA Trivia at Ponysaurus Brewing Co.
events.tagline: Join an entertaining evening of gaming-inspired trivia and community building at Raleigh's Ponysaurus Brewing Co.
events.description: Calling all gamers, this event features gaming-inspired trivia questions and community building in a fun evening setting at Ponysaurus Brewing Co. in Raleigh [1].

events.name: Master Strokes 2026 - Meet the Artist: A. Thilak Reddy
events.tagline: Meet Kalamkari artist A. Thilak Reddy for an immersive evening of artistic mastery at Cary Arts Center.
events.description: Join Leela Foundation for a Meet the Artist session with renowned Kalamkari practitioner A. Thilak Reddy as part of the Master Strokes 2026 celebration, featuring insights into this extraordinary textile art form [1][2].

events.name: Monthly Mayhem America Buck Yeah
events.tagline: Ride the mechanical bull at Cary's 21+ sports bar during the monthly Mayhem event
events.description: Monthly Mayhem America Buck Yeah is a mechanical bull riding event at PBR Cowboy Bar Cary, a 21+ sports bar in Cary, NC, open Friday from 7 PM to 2 AM[1][3].

events.name: The Move with Jermania at Bitter Social
events.tagline: A monthly First Friday dance party with DJ Jermania to start your month with energy and movement.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7 PM–2 AM · Doors open 7 PM, Jermania starts 9 PM
events.description: The Move with Jermania is a monthly dance event at Bitter Social in Downtown Raleigh featuring funk, pop, disco, and more, with doors opening at 7 PM and DJ Jermania starting at 9 PM [1][2].

events.name: Keller Williams
events.tagline: Late show blues and folk concert with Keller Williams at Raleigh's Lincoln Theatre
events.description: Keller Williams performs a late show at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on Friday, July 17, 2026, with doors opening at 10:30 PM and the show starting at 11:30 PM[1][2].

events.name: Wombo at Pinhook
events.tagline: An evening of innovative sound with Wombo taking the stage at The Pinhook
events.description: Wombo performs an evening of innovative sound at The Pinhook in Durham, NC on Friday, July 17, 2026, with the show starting at 8:00 PM[1][4].

events.name: Lucky Feeling w/ Shutdown, Start Today, Overthrow, Broken Bonds & Get Wise Kings
events.tagline: Hardcore and punk rock night featuring five local and regional bands at KINGS
events.description: Lucky Feeling presents a Friday night hardcore and punk show at KINGS in Downtown Raleigh with Shutdown, Start Today, Overthrow, Broken Bonds, and Get Wise Kings.

events.name: Necromancy Goth Night w/ Saiph
events.tagline: Monthly goth night featuring live music from Saiph and DJs Dr Martin and Velvet Fool at Raleigh's Chapel of Bones.
events.description: Necromancy Goth Night returns with live performance by Saiph, plus DJ Dr Martin and DJ Velvet Fool, at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh on Friday, July 17, 2026.

events.name: Burns and the Torchlights
events.tagline: Live music performance at Raleigh's iconic dive bar
events.description: Burns and the Torchlights perform live music from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM on Friday, July 17, 2026, at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh, NC [1][2].

events.name: Phish Afterparty: with Kendall Street Company
events.tagline: Kendall Street Company takes the stage for the official Phish afterparty at The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Kendall Street Company performs live at The Pour House for the Phish Afterparty on Friday, July 17, 2026, with doors opening at 10:30 PM and the show starting at 11:30 PM[1][2].

events.name: 2026 KX Kids Consignment Sale
events.tagline: The nation's largest kids consignment sale with free admission and discounted children's items.
events.venue: Jim Graham Building at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.scheduleNote: Fri 9 AM–6 PM · Sat 9 AM–4 PM · Sun 9 AM–5 PM
events.description: This free-admission event is the largest kids consignment sale in the nation, featuring over a mile of clothing racks and hundreds of tables with discounted children's clothing, toys, car seats, and baby items at the NC State Fairgrounds in Raleigh[1][11].

events.name: Raleigh 600 Sports Card, TCG, Toy, Pokémon, One Piece & Collectibles Expo
events.tagline: North Carolina's largest collectibles expo featuring vintage to modern toys, sports cards, Pokémon, comics, and TCG tournaments.
events.venue: Agri Supply Exposition Center at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.scheduleNote: Fri 1–6 PM (VIP 12 PM); Sat 9–4 PM; Sun 10–4 PM
events.description: The Raleigh 600 is a multi-day collectibles expo at the NC State Fairgrounds featuring sports cards, Pokémon, TCG tournaments, vintage toys, comics, and One Piece collectibles, with admission starting at $8.

events.name: Summer at the Springs Featuring Dark Echoes (Pink Floyd Experience)
events.tagline: Free outdoor Pink Floyd tribute concert with food trucks and local beer on the lawn.
events.description: Dark Echoes delivers a live Pink Floyd tribute experience at the Summer at the Springs concert series, featuring an outdoor concert, food trucks, and locally brewed beer and wine for sale.

events.name: Raleighoke Live Band Karaoke 2026
events.tagline: Unleash your inner rockstar by singing on stage with a live band at Tap Yard Raleigh.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7 PM–12 AM · Signups open at 7 PM, show starts at 8 PM
events.description: Raleighoke Live Band Karaoke 2026 brings the monthly live band karaoke show back to Tap Yard Raleigh, where participants can pick from 90+ songs and perform on stage backed by the Raleighoke band with scrolling lyrics[2][3].

events.name: America $2.50 - A Mettlesome Sketch Comedy Show
events.tagline: Buckle up for a sketch-comedy road trip across a great nation that sometimes feels like it’s worth about two bucks and fifty cents.
events.description: Mettlesome's ensemble tackles the absurdities of modern American life under head writer and director Bryan Tucker, with an eight-person cast bringing new sketches to the stage.

events.name: Bakari Sellers
events.tagline: CNN analyst, attorney, and bestselling author brings sharp political insight and Southern sensibility to Durham for an evening of conversation followed by a book signing.
events.description: CNN political analyst, attorney, and author Bakari Sellers hosts an evening of conversation on race, resilience, and democracy at the Hayti Heritage Center, followed by a book signing for his works 'My Vanishing Country' and 'The Moment'.

events.name: Ghost Story Open Mic
events.tagline: Share your favorite spooky tales at Carrboro's open mic for ghost stories
events.description: Ghost Story Open Mic is a free weekly event at Dingo Dog Brewing Co. where attendees share original or favorite ghost stories in an open mic format.

events.name: Cup of Excellence Nicaragua 2026 Winners Coffee Tasting
events.tagline: Taste award-winning coffees from the 2026 Nicaragua Cup of Excellence Competition
events.description: A unique in-person tasting of award-winning coffees from the 2026 Nicaragua Cup of Excellence Competition, with limited space available.

events.name: Live Band Karaoke
events.tagline: Grab the microphone and rock center stage with a live band backing your favorite hit songs.
events.description: Live Band Karaoke at Mystic Farm and Distillery features a live backing band for singers on Friday evenings from 7 to 10 PM, with tickets including one free cocktail.

events.name: First Day Back
events.tagline: Ethel Meserve and gapyear headline the Friday night show at Cat's Cradle
events.description: First Day Back is a Friday night music event at Cat's Cradle in Carrboro featuring performers Ethel Meserve and gapyear, with doors at 7 PM and the show starting at 8 PM[1][2].

events.name: Ahn with Galvenukles, Desidirium, and Orgone Energy Accumulator
events.tagline: Local 506 presents an all-ages night featuring Ahn and three local experimental acts.
events.description: Ahn performs with local experimental bands Galvenukles, Desidirium, and Orgone Energy Accumulator at Chapel Hill's Local 506, with doors opening at 7 PM and the show starting at 8 PM[1].

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Asheboro Zookeepers
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League home game featuring Y Guides Night at 6:30 PM
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders host the Asheboro Zookeepers in a Coastal Plain League home game with Y Guides Night on Friday, July 17, 2026 at 6:30 PM.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Martinsville Mustangs
events.tagline: Margaritaville Night: collegiate summer baseball with specialty jersey auctions
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Martinsville Mustangs at Five County Stadium for Margaritaville Night, featuring specialty jersey auctions and games starting at 6:30 PM on Friday, July 17, 2026[1][2].

events.name: Raleigh Restaurant Week at Sullivan's Steakhouse
events.tagline: Enjoy a special three-course prix fixe menu for $55 during Downtown Raleigh Restaurant Week.
events.description: Sullivan's Steakhouse participates in Downtown Raleigh Restaurant Week (July 16–26, 2026) with a three-course prix fixe menu featuring signature dishes like Hand-Cut Filet Mignon and Key Lime Pie for $55[3][4].

events.name: World Rugby Nations Cup, USA vs. Spain
events.tagline: USA takes on Spain in Round 3 of the inaugural World Rugby Nations Cup at WakeMed Soccer Park.
events.venue: First Horizon Stadium at WakeMed Soccer Park
events.scheduleNote: Sat Jul 18, 2026 at 7:00 PM (local) · 11:30 PM UTC
events.description: The USA Eagles face Spain in Round 3 of the inaugural World Rugby Nations Cup at First Horizon Stadium in Cary, NC, with matches broadcast on CBS Sports Network and available on RugbyPass TV[1][6][8].

events.name: Family Movie Night at Joyner Park 2026
events.tagline: Enjoy an outdoor screening of Mufasa: The Lion King under the stars at Wake Forest's Joyner Park.
events.description: The Town of Wake Forest hosts a free outdoor movie night featuring Mufasa: The Lion King on Saturday, July 18, 2026, with pre-show activities starting at 7:30 PM and the film at 8:30 PM[1][7].

events.name: Farm to Fork Kids Fest
events.tagline: Marbles transforms into a living farm-to-fork discovery zone with interactive food journey stations for kids.
events.description: Explore the journey food takes from earth to table through hands-on discovery stations and interactive labs on the museum's first floor and Playway, presented by the Center for Environmental Farming Systems (CEFS) [1][2][3].

events.name: Summer Sidewalk Sale
events.tagline: Shop up to 75% off designer brands and local goods at North Hills' annual sidewalk sale with a chance to win a $500 shopping spree.
events.description: The annual Summer Sidewalk Sale at North Hills runs July 16–19, 2026, featuring up to 75% off at 20+ participating stores with sales on designer brands, local goods, books, and decor [1][2][3].

events.name: Animation Is Art Film Screening and Lecture: All You Need Is Kill (2025)
events.tagline: Screen Kenichiro Akimoto’s sci-fi anime 'All You Need Is Kill' followed by a talkback with NC State’s Dr. Mina Kaneko.
events.description: The North Carolina Museum of Art presents a screening of the 2025 animated sci-fi film 'All You Need Is Kill,' directed by Kenichiro Akimoto, followed by a post-screening talkback with Dr. Mina Kaneko from NC State [1][2].

events.name: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA
events.tagline: An atmospheric candlelit concert celebrating the greatest hits of Queen and ABBA.
events.description: This 60-minute Candlelight concert features live performances of Queen and ABBA songs in a venue filled with up to 30,000 candles at The Rialto in Downtown Raleigh [1][3].

events.name: Candlelight: Tribute to Fleetwood Mac
events.tagline: Experience Fleetwood Mac's timeless hits in an intimate, candlelit atmosphere at The Rialto.
events.scheduleNote: Sat Jul 18 – Sat Aug 29, 6:30 PM – 7:45 PM
events.description: Candlelight: Tribute to Fleetwood Mac brings the legendary band's hits to life in a multi-sensory, candlelit concert series at The Rialto Theatre in Raleigh, running from July 18 through August 29, 2026.

events.name: Dinosaur Adventure
events.tagline: Life-sized animatronic dinosaurs, fossil digs, and interactive prehistoric activities for the whole family.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 12–8 PM · Sat 9–7 PM · Sun 9–6 PM
events.description: Dinosaur Adventure is a fully indoor, family-friendly event at the NC State Fairgrounds featuring life-sized dinosaurs, fossil digs, raptor training sessions, baby dino meet-and-greets, bounce houses, and dino scooters [1][2][3].

events.name: Raleigh Twilight Market at Smoky Hollow
events.tagline: Monthly night market with 30+ local vendors, live DJ, food, drinks, and performances
events.description: The Raleigh Twilight Market is a monthly evening market on the 3rd Saturday featuring 30+ local vendors, live DJ music, food, beer, wine, and performances at Smoky Hollow in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Triangle Pop Up – Maker’s Market
events.tagline: Shop dozens of local artisans and makers while enjoying live music at Fenton Square.
events.description: Triangle Pop Up’s Maker’s Market is a monthly event on the 3rd Saturday featuring 35+ local artists, handmade goods, and live music at Fenton Square in Cary.

events.name: World Soccer – Watch Parties for all Nations
events.tagline: Daily watch parties for every 2026 FIFA World Cup match at Sports & Social Cary
events.scheduleNote: Fri 9–11 PM · Recurring daily through July 19
events.description: Sports & Social in Cary hosts daily watch parties for all 2026 FIFA World Cup matches from July 11–19, with Friday sessions at 9–11 PM and walk-ins welcome though reservations are recommended[1].

events.name: Book Harvest’s Summer Block Party
events.tagline: A free, outdoor celebration of books, summer, and community with 15,000 free children’s books and family fun.
events.description: Book Harvest’s 6th annual Summer Block Party is a free community event on Saturday, July 18, 2026, featuring magic shows, storytime, poetry, and 15,000 culturally inclusive children’s books for all ages at Durham Central Park[1][2].

events.name: American Craft Council OPEN STUDIOS at LIBERTY ARTS
events.tagline: Join the nationwide Open Studios Weekend to explore over 10 artists' creative spaces in Durham.
events.description: This event is part of the American Craft Council's National Craft Open Studios Weekend, inviting the public into Liberty Arts' studio to see artists working in glass, jewelry, metal casting, welding, and ceramics [1]. Attendees can enjoy demonstrations, chat with working artists, and purchase handmade pieces during the Saturday-only open house from 4 to 8 PM [1].

events.name: NCModernist Art Sale Fundraiser
events.tagline: Discover over 250 original art pieces from the 1970s and 1980s at this free admission fundraiser.
events.description: NCModernist hosts an art sale fundraiser featuring more than 250 original prints, watercolors, and paintings by MFA candidates from the University of Michigan and Cranbrook Academy of Art, priced at $29 for unsigned works and $59 for signed works[1][2].

events.name: SOS: The Recession Pop Party
events.tagline: A 21+ pop DJ party kicking off at 9 PM and playing until midnight
events.scheduleNote: Sat Jul 18, 2026 9:00 PM · Doors 8:30 PM · DJs play until midnight
events.description: SOS: The Recession Pop Party is a 21+ dance event at Motorco Music Hall in Durham featuring DJs who start at 9 PM and play until midnight, with advance tickets priced at $22.45[1].

events.name: Glow Party
events.tagline: EDM and house music with DJ Resynova under the glow lights
events.description: Join DJ Resynova spinning EDM and house music from 9pm to midnight at this free Glow Party featuring $5 green tea shots and $20 domestic buckets.

events.name: Tangled Vows - The Play
events.tagline: The gripping stage play makes its North Carolina debut with a single Saturday performance in Raleigh.
events.venue: A.J. Fletcher Opera Theater at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Tangled Vows is a gripping stage play making its North Carolina debut at the Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts in Raleigh on Saturday, July 18, 2026 [1][6].

events.name: Sun Prints as Personal Archiving with Shiloh Jines
events.tagline: Create a unique cyanotype photogram using sunlight, plants, and personal objects to preserve memories and connections to nature.
events.description: Participants will learn cyanotype photography, a cameraless process using sunlight to create blue-and-white prints inspired by Anna Atkins' botanical photographs, incorporating plants, natural materials, and personal objects to reflect memories and inspiration[2].

events.name: American Revolution Experience
events.tagline: A free, innovative pop-up exhibition connecting visitors to the people and places that shaped the birth of our nation.
events.venue: Gathering House at Downtown Cary Park
events.description: This traveling historical exhibit uses storytelling, illustration, technology, and unique artifacts to connect audiences with the American Revolution, featuring simple crafts for young readers [1][2].

events.name: 11th Annual Blueberry Fest
events.tagline: Celebrate blueberry season with u-pick berries, local food, live music, and family fun at Cedar Grove Blueberry Farm.
events.description: The 11th Annual Blueberry Fest at Cedar Grove Blueberry Farm features u-pick blueberries, wood-fired pizza, fresh donuts, blueberry lemonade, live music, face painting, and craft beer. Admission is $5 per person.

events.name: 2nd Annual Four Feet To Hell Charity Hotdog Eating Contest
events.tagline: Compete in a charity hotdog eating contest and squatwurst challenge to support Meals on Wheels of Durham.
events.scheduleNote: Sat 1–6 PM · Hot Dog Contest @ 2 PM · Squatwurst @ 3 PM
events.description: The 2nd Annual Four Feet To Hell features a charity hotdog eating contest at 2 PM and a squatwurst competition at 3 PM, with all proceeds benefiting Meals on Wheels of Durham [1].

events.name: Art and Blooms at the JCRA: Garden Pathways
events.tagline: Create floral arrangements inspired by garden pathways at NC State's JC Raulston Arboretum
events.venue: JC Raulston Arboretum at North Carolina State University
events.freeNote: $5 nonmembers, $10 per family; free for JCRA members and NC State students with ID
events.description: This hands-on workshop at the JC Raulston Arboretum guides participants in creating floral arrangements themed around garden pathways, held Saturday, July 18, 2026 at 10 AM [1][2].

events.name: Biltmore Hills Park Master Plan: Public Meeting
events.tagline: Drop in to explore the draft concept plan and share your vision for Biltmore Hills Park's future improvements.
events.description: Raleigh Parks invites residents to explore the draft concept plan for the Biltmore Hills Park Master Plan Update at the playground, featuring popcorn, snow cones, games, and a cooled indoor area to learn about proposed improvements [2].

events.name: Designing Dix Hospital: Past, Present & Future
events.tagline: A lecture exploring the architectural history and future plans of Dix Park's McBryde building, the first mental health hospital in North Carolina.
events.description: This free lecture by PhD candidate Bryan Rusch traces the design journey of the McBryde building from its 1848 sketch to its 1856 opening and future prospects, with registration required due to limited space[1][2].

events.name: Encore Market - The Green Room
events.tagline: A Saturday market event featuring local vendors, food, and drinks at The Green Room in Raleigh.
events.description: Encore Market is a Saturday market held at The Green Room in North Raleigh, offering local vendors, food, and arts.

events.name: Johnny Guitar
events.tagline: A classic 1954 Western drama screened in 35mm at The Cary Theater
events.description: Johnny Guitar is a 1954 Western drama about a saloon owner wrongly suspected of murder, presented in 35mm at The Cary Theater in Cary, NC [2][10].

events.name: Songstories Live
events.tagline: An inspiring night of three singer-songwriters sharing original songs and the stories behind them.
events.description: Songstories Live is an intimate gathering where three singer-songwriters perform original songs and share the stories behind them, backed by local session artists at Boxyard RTP's BeatBox Stage[2][3].

events.name: SHEBAD
events.tagline: Canadian R&B band SHEBAD brings their high-energy live show to Durham's Stanczyks
events.description: SHEBAD, an R&B group from Guelph, ON, performs at Stanczyks Music Bar in Durham on Saturday, July 18, 2026 at 8 PM [1][2][8].

events.name: Bird and Byron
events.tagline: Local duo Bird and Byron take the stage at Cat’s Cradle Back Room
events.description: Bird and Byron perform live on Saturday, July 18, 2026, at Cat’s Cradle Back Room in Carrboro, NC, with doors opening at 7 pm and the show starting at 8 pm[1][2].

events.name: Mella – 'Or So We've Been Touring...
events.tagline: Progressive post-hardcore band Mella brings their summer tour to Chapel Hill with Body Thief and Postdrome.
events.description: Mella performs their 'Or So We've Been Touring...' show at Local 506 on Saturday, July 18, 2026, featuring support from Body Thief and Postdrome [1][2].

events.name: Live Music: Nick Mardon
events.tagline: Blues-Rock guitarist and singer Nick Mardon performs live every 3rd Saturday at Saints and Scholars Irish Pub in Raleigh.
events.description: Nick Mardon, a Blues-Rock guitarist and singer from the Seattle area, performs live at Saints and Scholars Irish Pub in Raleigh as part of his 2026 residency, playing every 3rd Saturday from 8–11 PM[1][2].

events.name: Pirates! A Boy At Sea
events.tagline: A swashbuckling adventure about a boy confronting fears and the meaning of family.
events.description: Pirates! A Boy At Sea follows eleven-year-old Jim Watts, whisked away by a treasure chest into a conflict between rival pirate and British captains, where he confronts fears and his fractured family [1]. Presented by Switch Theatre Co., this 75-minute production is ideal for young audiences and parents seeking stories about emotional healing [1][4].

events.name: Dan Davis and Danger Hall
events.tagline: Live music night featuring Dan Davis and Danger Hall at Slim's Dive Bar
events.description: Dan Davis and Danger Hall perform live music on Saturday, July 18, 2026, from 9–11 PM at Slim's Dive Bar in Downtown Raleigh with free admission[1][3].

events.name: The Pietasters w/ Ruler
events.tagline: The Pietasters bring their ska-rock sound to Raleigh with Ruler opening the show
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: The Pietasters perform live at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh on Saturday, July 18, 2026, with Ruler as the opening act. Doors open at 8:00 PM and the show starts at 9:00 PM for a 21+ audience[1].

events.name: Metal Yoga: Ozz-yasa
events.tagline: Yoga meets metal music at Raleigh's iconic Chapel of Bones
events.description: A unique yoga session themed around metal music, held at Chapel of Bones, a metal venue and coffee lounge in Raleigh. Tickets are available in advance via the event link or at the door if not sold out[7].

events.name: Raleigh Vs Everybody Official Silent Party
events.tagline: 3 live DJs playing hip hop, R&B, and Afrobeats for an unforgettable silent disco party you'll never forget.
events.description: A unique nightlife experience where attendees use wireless headphones to listen to multiple live DJs simultaneously, featuring hip hop, R&B, and Afrobeats at Nuvo Lounge and Bar in Raleigh.

events.name: Somatic House Presents Airwaves at Bitter Social
events.tagline: A house music event series with a global sound and local feel, featuring residents and favorite local selectors.
events.description: Somatic House Collective presents Airwaves, a house music event at Bitter Social in Downtown Raleigh featuring local and global selectors on Saturday, May 9, 2026.

events.name: Chris Boerner
events.tagline: Monk Tribute Jazz Night featuring Chris Boerner
events.description: Chris Boerner performs a Thelonious Monk tribute jazz night at Neptune's in Raleigh, with doors opening at 8 PM and the show starting at 9 PM.

events.name: Dreamforia presents Progressive House Forever
events.tagline: An immersive electronic dance music festival dedicated to the sophisticated sounds of progressive house.
events.description: Dreamforia presents Progressive House Forever is an immersive electronic dance music festival dedicated to the sophisticated sounds of the progressive house genre[1].

events.name: From Eden to Arcadia: A Drag & Burlesque Tribute to Sleep Token
events.tagline: A drag and burlesque performance celebrating Sleep Token's album Even in Arcadia
events.description: This Saturday night event at Chapel of Bones features drag and burlesque performers paying tribute to Sleep Token's progressive metal-rock album Even in Arcadia, which released May 9, 2026[1][4][5].

events.name: Glitter Drop: A Burlesque Rave Experience
events.tagline: A high-energy collision of burlesque and rave culture where striptease meets the drop.
events.description: Glitter Drop is an immersive event combining professional burlesque performances with high-energy electronic dance music in a neon-soaked rave setting[1][2].

events.name: Live Music at TBL Cafe ft. Kenny Shores
events.tagline: Enjoy live music with Kenny Shore and Brad Moody Jr. at The Bike Library's TBL Cafe
events.description: Live music performance featuring Kenny Shore and Brad Moody Jr. at the TBL Cafe inside The Bike Library in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Mama Afrika Pop-Up Market
events.tagline: A vibrant Saturday pop-up market featuring African-inspired vendors, food, and culture at Triangle Town Center.
events.description: The Mama Afrika Pop-Up Market is a Saturday event at Triangle Town Center in Raleigh featuring African-inspired vendors, food, and cultural offerings. Admission is free for visitors.

events.name: FC 26 LAN Tournament
events.tagline: Compete in a local EA FC 26 LAN tournament at Ego Chall Esports in Chapel Hill.
events.description: A Saturday LAN tournament for EA SPORTS FC 26 held at Ego Chall Esports in Chapel Hill, NC. Specific date, time, and ticket details are available via the event link.

events.name: Still She Stands
events.tagline: A final battle for Queen Elizabeth I against Time, Death, and the ghosts of lost loves.
events.description: Midnight Oil Productions presents a workshop production of 'Still She Stands' featuring 12 local actors in a story about Queen Elizabeth I's final battle with Time, Death, and lost loves [1].

events.name: 2026 Tomato Fest
events.tagline: Celebrate local tomatoes at the Eno River Farmers' Market with fresh produce, recipes, and community fun.
events.description: The 2026 Tomato Fest is a community celebration of local tomatoes held at the Eno River Farmers' Market in Hillsborough on Saturday, July 18, 2026, featuring fresh produce, tomato-themed activities, and family-friendly fun.

events.name: Hello, Dolly!
events.tagline: The Tony Award-winning musical about a bold matchmaker who meddles in love.
events.venue: Joan H. Gillings Center for Dramatic Art
events.description: PlayMakers’ Summer Youth Conservatory presents this classic musical set in turn-of-the-century New York, following matchmaker Dolly Levi as she meddles in love. The show runs July 16–26, 2026, with tickets at $20 for adults and $10 for youth.

events.name: Tarot and Art History: Made by You
events.tagline: Create your own tarot cards while exploring art history in this hands-on workshop.
events.description: This indoor workshop on the 5th floor of Horseshoe RTP guides participants aged 10+ to design their own tarot cards while learning about art history [1]. Each participant must purchase a $30 ticket to attend [1].

events.name: Superintendent’s Revenge Golf Tournament
events.tagline: 4-man scramble golf tournament with shotgun start at Hillandale Golf Course
events.description: The Superintendent’s Revenge Golf Tournament is a 4-man scramble event featuring a shotgun start at Hillandale Golf Course in Durham, NC, beginning at 9:00 AM on Saturday.

events.name: Songstories Live at Boxyard RTP
events.tagline: An inspiring night of three singer-songwriters sharing original songs and the stories behind them.
events.description: Songstories Live is an intimate gathering where three singer-songwriters perform original songs and share the stories behind them, backed by local session artists at the BeatBox Stage.

events.name: 2026 Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: Free Sunday evening concerts featuring local artists at Fred Fletcher Park
events.description: The 2026 Summer Concert Series at Fred Fletcher Park features free Sunday evening performances by local artists from 6 to 8 p.m., running through August 16, 2026[1][3].

events.name: Vishal-Sheykhar - The Superhit Tour
events.tagline: Bollywood's biggest musical duo Vishal and Sheykhar bring their Superhit Tour of iconic film songs to Raleigh.
events.venue: Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Singer-songwriter duo Vishal and Sheykhar perform live in concert on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium, featuring a power-packed set of Bollywood superhits from their 2026 U.S. tour [1][8].

events.name: World Cup Final Watch Party with Casamigos
events.tagline: Catch the World Cup Final action at Tap Yard with Casamigos starting at 3pm on Sunday, July 19.
events.scheduleNote: Doors at 2 PM · Match at 3 PM
events.description: Join fans at Tap Yard Raleigh to watch the FIFA Men's World Cup Final on Sunday, July 19, with Casamigos hosting the event; doors open at 2 PM and the match starts at 3 PM.

events.name: World Cup Finals Watch Party with The NC Courage
events.tagline: Join The NC Courage at Fenton Square to watch the 2026 FIFA World Cup final on the big screen with food samples and drink specials.
events.description: The NC Courage hosts a free World Cup Finals watch party at Fenton Square in Cary on Saturday, July 18, 2026 (not Sunday), featuring food samples, drink specials, and the game on a big screen [1].

events.name: Final Watch Party
events.tagline: Free Sunday watch party for the Men's World Cup Final with drink specials and live streaming in the Lift Bay.
events.description: Raleigh Sister Cities presents a free watch party for the Men's Soccer World Cup Final at Transfer Co. Food Hall, featuring live streaming in the Lift Bay and drink specials.

events.name: Ice Cream Social 2026
events.tagline: Celebrate National Ice Cream Day with free ice cream, iced tea, lemonade, and family fun.
events.description: The Town of Fuquay-Varina hosts a free Ice Cream Social on Sunday, July 19, 2026, from 4–6 PM at Fuquay Mineral Spring Park, offering free ice cream, iced tea, and lemonade to celebrate National Ice Cream Day[1][3].

events.name: T. Murph
events.tagline: American comedian rising from the Chicago scene stars in Hulu's WOKE
events.description: T. Murph, an American comedian and actor from the Chicago comedy scene, performs at Raleigh Improv in Cary on Sunday, July 19, 2026 at 6 PM[1][5]. He currently stars in Hulu's comedy series WOKE alongside Lamorne Morris and Rose McIver[5].

events.name: The Cary Vintage Market
events.tagline: Monthly vintage market featuring 18+ vendors selling sustainable fashion, records, and housewares in Cary's Biergarten.
events.venue: Biergarten between Vicious Fishes Cary/South Line Brewing
events.description: The Cary Vintage Market is a monthly event held at the Biergarten between Vicious Fishes Brewery and South Line Brewing, featuring over 18 vintage vendors selling curated clothing, records, housewares, and memorabilia[1][3].

events.name: The Maxwell's Summer Showcase
events.tagline: A Sunday afternoon summer showcase at The Maxwell in Raleigh
events.description: The Maxwell's Summer Showcase is a Sunday event at 4:00 PM held at The Maxwell wedding and event venue in South Raleigh, featuring summer-themed activities.

events.name: Slumbering Sun - Durham
events.tagline: Live music night at Durham's iconic indie venue The Pinhook
events.description: Slumbering Sun performs at The Pinhook in Durham on Sunday, July 19, 2026, as part of a local music showcase.

events.name: Hello, Dolly! Matinee
events.tagline: The Summer Youth Conservatory presents the Tony Award-winning musical of the bold matchmaker Dolly Levi.
events.venue: Joan H. Gillings Center for Dramatic Art
events.description: Set in turn-of-the-century New York, this musical follows the charming matchmaker Dolly Levi as she meddles in love, presented by PlayMakers’ Summer Youth Conservatory [1].

events.name: Tropical Drinks & Tropical Terrariums Terrarium Workshop
events.tagline: Build your own tropical terrarium while enjoying signature tropical drinks at Yonder.
events.description: This adult-only workshop at Yonder in Hillsborough combines hands-on terrarium building with tropical drink tastings, offering a creative and social Sunday experience.

events.name: Emo Karaoke! Get Sad Y'all
events.tagline: Sing your favorite emo songs from all decades every 3rd Sunday at Neptunes Parlour.
events.description: Emo Karaoke! Get Sad Y'all is a monthly recurring event on the 3rd Sunday of each month at Neptunes Parlour in Downtown Raleigh, where attendees can sing classic and modern emo songs from all decades with free admission.

events.name: Alukah / Deathless / Celaris / Homicyde / Fault Reset
events.tagline: Heavy metal showcase featuring Alukah, Deathless, Celaris, Homicyde, and Fault Reset at Chapel of Bones.
events.description: A live music event featuring five heavy metal bands performing at Chapel of Bones, a coffee shop and music venue in West Raleigh.

events.name: Kirkos
events.tagline: Live music performance by Kirkos at Slim's Dive Bar
events.description: Kirkos performs live music from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at Slim's Dive Bar in Downtown Raleigh, with free admission.

events.name: Love Never Fails Dance Party
events.tagline: An inclusive daytime dance event fostering community connection through music and movement
events.description: Love Never Fails is an inclusive daytime dance party at Bitter Social in Downtown Raleigh, designed to foster community connection through music and movement [1][4].

events.name: Meet Our Guest Stars Fitness - American Dance Festival
events.tagline: Join the American Dance Festival for a fun Sunday fitness class led by guest stars at Marbles Kids Museum.
events.description: This Sunday fitness event features guest stars from the American Dance Festival and is held at Marbles Kids Museum in Downtown Raleigh, with admission included in the museum's regular ticket price[1].

events.name: Nail Bite x Dying Oath x Strange Culture
events.tagline: High-energy heavy alternative music night featuring Nail Bite, Dying Oath, and Strange Culture
events.description: Nail Bite, Dying Oath, and Strange Culture perform high-energy heavy alternative music at Cannonball Music Hall in Midtown Raleigh [1].

events.name: Time Out Of Mind – A tribute to Bob Dylan
events.tagline: A live musical tribute celebrating the songs and legacy of Bob Dylan
events.description: Time Out Of Mind is a tribute concert featuring performances of Bob Dylan's music at the Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on Sunday, July 19, 2026.

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Peninsula Pilots
events.tagline: Collegiate summer baseball game between the Devil Dogz and Peninsula Pilots at Five County Stadium
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Peninsula Pilots in a collegiate summer baseball game at Five County Stadium on Sunday, July 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM.
